matches.quote: Tip-induced band bending (TIBB) and charging are not separated ... A charge state switches once the level crosses E_F under the tip, which gives ... charging rings in dI/dV maps.
show maps of the gap magnitude, gap-centre energy and normal-state peak energy over the area of Fig. 4a, show that the gap is actually reduced in type-II regions
p. 5: "crystal field splitting ... typically ~100 times smaller than the energy of excitonic gap" needs a reference or an estimate. A ~1 meV crystal-field splitting is implausible
state how many defects of each type show the same trends, give the numbers of crystals, cleaves and tips
Vacancies are assigned to Te1–Te4 sites from decorated-tip images alone (Fig. 2b, Fig. S2). No simulated STM images or formation-energy arguments exclude adatoms, antisites or subsurface defects
Ref. 41 (Kwon et al.) reports YSR-like bound states in an exciton condensate, the same physics. State briefly where the observations and interpretation agree or differ
The central assignment, that the vacancy-induced in-gap pair ... consists of excitonic pair-breaking states, is not distinguished from ordinary defect levels in a narrow-gap semiconductor
report the fitted J1,2 for each vacancy type and link them to the 2δ ordering in Fig. 2d
Type-I and type-II regions are distinguished only by the energy of a "characteristic normal-state peak" ... give a consistent mapping from spectral features to imbalance
show whether the continuum gap edges move with I_t (TIBB would move them) alongside the subgap peaks; map dI/dV(r, V) around a defect over a range of tip heights
Language: "predicated" → "predicted" (p. 5); "formulism" → "formalism" (p. 6); "splitted" → "split"; "tends to emerge" → "tend to emerge" ... other grammatical slips.

Topographs are taken with both a "normal" tip and a Ta2Pd3Te5-cluster-decorated tip ... state which tip was used for each spectrum in Figs. 1–4, and show that the subgap peaks ... are reproduced with metallic tips

notes: C10, C11 and C12 concern the massless Dirac Hamiltonian in Supplementary Sec.
